violations.text: The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was blocked by kitchen utensils and equipment. A hand-washing sink shall be accessible at all times for employee use. Equipment and utensils were moved during the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/16/2026
Refrigerator door gaskets were observed in poor repair on the walk-in cooler. Refrigerator door gaskets shall be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 07/16/2026

The ceiling in the back food preparation area is covered with tiles that are not smooth, durable, and easily cleanable. Establishment is to install ceiling tiles that are smooth, durable, easily cleanable, and non-absorbent. New Violation. Correct By: 09/16/2026

Protective shielding is not provided for the lights in the back food preparation area. Light bulbs must be shielded, coated, or otherwise shatter-resistant in areas where there is exposed food; clean equipment, utensils, and linens; or unwrapped single-service and single-use articles. New Violation. Correct By: 07/16/2026
